-- Since 18 = 2 × 9, the number must be divisible by both 2 and 9.
  -- Divisibility by 2 requires the last digit to be even, so n ∈ {0,2,4,6,8}.
  -- Divisibility by 9 requires the sum of digits to be divisible by 9.
  -- The sum of digits is 3 + 7 + 4 + n = 14 + n.
  -- So we need 14 + n ≡ 0 mod 9 ⇒ n ≡ 4 mod 9.
  -- Since n ∈ {0,2,4,6,8} and n ≤ 9, the only solution is n = 4.

  -- First, show n ∈ {0,2,4,6,8} by contradiction.
  intro hn
  cases hn with n'
  exact Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀) (Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le h₀)

  -- Now check n = 4 satisfies the divisibility condition.
  have h2 : 18 ∣ 374 * 10 + 4 := by
    ring

  -- Show 18 ∣ 374 * 10 + n implies n = 4 by contradiction.
  intro h
  have hsum : 18 ∣ 14 + n := by
    -- 374 * 10 + n = 3740 + n = 18 × 207 + (14 + n)
    -- So 18 ∣ (18 × 207 + (14 + n)) ⇒ 18 ∣ (14 + n)
    ring

  -- We know 18 ∣ (14 + n) and n ∈ {0,2,4,6,8} ⇒ n ≡ 4 mod 9
  have hmod : 14 + n ≡ 0 mod 9 := by
    -- 14 + n ≡ 0 mod 9 ⇒ n ≡ -14 ≡ 4 mod 9
    ring

  -- Since n ∈ {0,2,4,6,8} and n ≡ 4 mod 9, n must be 4.
  cases n with n''
  exact Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀) (Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le h₀)
  have hn' : n'' = 4 := by
    -- Show n'' ≡ 4 mod 9
    have hn''_mod : n'' ≡ 4 mod 9 := by
      -- By definition of Nat.mod
      exact Nat.mod_eq_of_le (Nat.mod_eq_of_le (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀) (Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le h₀)) (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀)
    -- Since n'' ≡ 4 mod 9 and n'' ∈ {0,2,4,6,8}, n'' must be 4
    cases n'' with n''''
    exact Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀) (Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le h₀)
    have hn'''_mod : n''' ≡ 4 mod 9 := by
      -- By definition of Nat.mod
      exact Nat.mod_eq_of_le (Nat.mod_eq_of_le (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀) (Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le h₀)) (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀)
    exact Nat.eq_of_mod_eq (Nat.mod_eq_of_le (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀) (Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le h₀)) hn''_mod hn'''_mod

  exact Nat.eq_of_mod_eq (Nat.mod_eq_of_le (Nat.succ_le_succ h₀) (Nat.zero_le_nat.le_of_le h₀)) hmod hn

                  exact nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (nat.zero_le _) (nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (nat.zero_le _) (nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (nat.zero_le _) (nat.lt_one_two))

                exact h10e
